newsitem.title: CHINA: China charges dissident over government plot.
newsitem.headline: China charges dissident over government plot.

text.p: Chinese prosecutors have charged dissident and former student leader Wang Dan with plotting to overthrow the government, Chinese sources close to the case said on Monday.
A court in Beijing was expected to deliver a verdict on Wang's case this week, said one source, who declined to be identified.
Wang, 26, faces up to seven years in jail on the charge, the source said.
Wang's family declined to comment on his whereabouts and said they had no news of their son.
Wang served four years in jail for counter-revolutionary, or subversive, activities for his role as a leader of the 1989 student-led pro-democracy movement.

He has been in security limbo since he was detained in May, 1995 in the run-up to the sixth anniversary of the June 1989 military crackdown in Beijing's Tiananmen Square that crushed the student protests.
